items.title: First cohomology with mu_n coefficients as pairs of an invertible sheaf with a trivialized n-th tensor power
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition identifies H^1_etale(S, mu_n) for n invertible on S, and H^1_fppf(S, mu_n) in general, with the group of isomorphism classes of pairs (L, alpha) where L is invertible and alpha : L^{tensor n} to O_S is a trivialization, a group introduced at etale-cohomology.tex lines 3000-3054. The proof must first manufacture the covering that trivializes the pair, V_i = Spec(A_i[T]/(T^n - f_i)) with f_i = alpha(s_i^{tensor n}), and then produce the class twice - as an explicit Cech 1-cocycle zeta_ij in mu_n on the double overlaps and as the mu_n-torsor of isomorphisms - before checking that the two agree, that the assignment is additive on tensor products, and that a trivial class forces a trivial pair (lines 3084-3149). What is not a formality is the surjectivity step at lines 3152-3169: an arbitrary class is pushed into H^1(., G_m), identified with an invertible sheaf via Hilbert 90, and the remaining difference is recognised as partial(f) using the Kummer long exact sequence; the upgrade from fppf to etale when n is invertible rests on the covering being etale in that case (lines 3171-3177).
